description: Use when you need the current gas price, an ethereum gas fee estimate before a transaction, or to compare gas fees across chains. Do not use for gas units of a given transaction, gas history or chains beyond Ethereum, Base and Solana. Returns JSON with the gas price and gas fees on Ethereum and Base (base fee, slow, standard and fast EIP-1559 fees in gwei, transfer cost) plus Solana priority fees for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.003 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

chains.description: Chains to read (ethereum, base and solana when omitted), e.g. ["base", "ethereum"]
